blocks.text: ROME, Italy — Germany, Romania and the United Kingdom on Tuesday joined the growing list of European countries hit by cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration systems in recent days. Italy’s government held emergency talks with intelligence chiefs on Tuesday following the incidents, which prompted the European Union (EU) to warn of a deliberate attempt to disrupt the bloc’s food supply chain. The motive for the cyberattacks remains unknown, and nobody has claimed responsibility.
